title: Scriptorium Lineage Graph v1
description: A research direction's 脉络 / lineage over a SET of own-library papers, built in two passes. (1) DETERMINISTIC: Steward `lineage` reads each paper's parsed-paper/1.0, emits one `node` per paper from its metadata, and walks the parsed `references` to add a `cites` edge wherever a reference matches another paper IN THE SET (by DOI when present, else normalized title) — `evidence` is that matched reference's raw string — plus a year-ordered `timeline`. (2) AGENT-ENRICHED: the `synthesize-direction` task may add typed relations (extends / supersedes / method-of / contrasts) and `cluster` assignments. Own-library only to start (no beyond-library / OpenAlex edges). Nodes join the rest of the suite by `citekey` = the Better BibTeX id. Steward can render a Markdown projection; Obsidian enhancements are optional. Provenance locally ingests validated files as reference-only research artifacts, not approved claims. Additive contract — supersedes nothing. See specs/literature-reading.md §3.

generated_by.description: Producer tag, e.g. "steward lineage" for the deterministic citation-graph pass.

direction.description: The research direction this graph scopes.

query.description: The question / topic that scoped the papers (passed in; may be empty for an ad-hoc paper set).

scope_method.description: How the papers were scoped, e.g. "own-library citation match" for the deterministic Steward pass.

created.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time when the graph was produced.

nodes.description: The papers in this direction. Each node is a paper keyed by its Better BibTeX citekey.

citekey.description: Better BibTeX citekey — the universal join id across the suite.

cluster.description: Id of the cluster (see clusters[].id) this node belongs to. OPTIONAL — assigned by the agent during synthesis, not the deterministic pass.

edges.description: Directed relationships between papers. The deterministic builder emits relation="cites"; the agent enriches the typed relations during synthesis.

relation.description: Relationship type. "cites" is the deterministic default; the others are agent-typed during synthesis.

evidence.description: What grounds this edge. For relation="cites" this is the matched reference's raw string from the citing paper's parsed-paper (anti-fabrication: the edge is read off real reference data, never invented).

clusters.description: Optional groupings of nodes into sub-directions / themes. Assigned by the agent during synthesis, not the deterministic pass.

timeline.description: Citekeys in year order — a chronological reading path through the direction.
